Recover unique z and beta, verify the quadratic root sum and product and complete sufficiency; one k leaves a continuum. Exact physical domain H>0, 0<=z<H, 0<beta<1, lambda in (0,1), both distinct modes, known gravity. Independently evaluated 250 random models and reflected data against the forward quadratic.
